evidence actually describes. Use its specific concept name when supported, even when the
source uses other words. Do not settle for labels such as "mechanism", "function" or
"strategy" when the source explains a more distinctive idea.

name over a broader technical term that adds an unstated process, cause or capability.

A passage can support more than one distinct concept. Group different passages only when
each supports the named concept. A single passage can be sufficient. Do not invent facts,
source IDs, or concepts that are only mentioned without substantive explanation.
